A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have successfully used the third-party copy feature of IPI-3 to transfer data directly from a HIPPI Disk Array to an IBM 3090 supercomputer, from the 3090 to a Sun 3/50 workstation, and between two HIPPI Disk Arrays.

The main takeaway from our work is that

it is possible to transfer data at high rates between client processors and networked storage devices or other client processors, and that it is possible for a storage device to act as a third-party copy target for other storage devices.
IPI-3 is a viable high-performance storage protocol that can be used in a variety of applications.
it is possible to transfer data at very high speeds (over 200 MB/sec) using third-party copy protocols and that the third-party copy protocols are a viable alternative for high-speed data transfers.
